name: harness-npm-tools
description: npm-distributed parts of the harness bundle: pi (SDK, TUI, AI), the bundled pi packages, the npm MCP servers, and harness's own dependencies (typebox, yaml, ignore, jiti; ws for the hub's WebSocket endpoint; qrcode for device pairing links; @modelcontextprotocol/server, zod and patchright for the browser MCP server; @xterm/headless for the test stand's screen captures). Versions are bumped by nix/update.sh; package-lock.json is generated, never edited by hand.
